description: Defines functions and types for mapping CCEs to PRBs in PDCCH transmissions within 5G NR, including CORESET0, non-interleaved, and interleaved mappings.

methods.name: cce_to_prb_mapping_coreset0
methods.description: Calculates PRB list for a CORESET0 PDCCH transmission based on start index, size, symbols, cell ID, aggregation level, and CCE index.

methods.name: cce_to_prb_mapping_non_interleaved
methods.description: Calculates PRB list for a non-interleaved PDCCH transmission based on BWP start, frequency resources, symbols, aggregation level, and CCE index.

methods.name: cce_to_prb_mapping_interleaved
methods.description: Calculates PRB list for an interleaved PDCCH transmission based on BWP start, frequency resources, symbols, reg bundle size, interleaver size, shift index, aggregation level, and CCE index.
